payload.rebuttal: argued: This probe mutates the body of the real worktree.spec_ids() at line 483, changing its git subcommand from 'grep' to 'log'. CellTree.spec_ids calls worktree.spec_ids(self.container) by module-attribute lookup, and my fix's entire purpose, dictated by the spec itself, is to replace that attribute with a stub before any test runs. Once replaced, the real function's body never executes in this test, so no assertion consistent with the stub existing can observe a mutation inside that body. Satisfying this probe would require not stubbing spec_ids, which is the exact regression this task fixes. saffron/cell/worktree.py is named explicitly in 'Out of scope' ('No production code here is wrong') and sits under the forbidden saffron/** path. The mutation is already caught by test_worktree.py::test_the_suite_judges_cited_ids_against_the_spec_files_at_head, named in the finding.
